subject: Charged twice for INV-10101
body: Amberline Tea Co. says their bank was debited $1,003.00 twice for INV-10101. Refund the duplicate.

subject: Dunning email showed the wrong balance
body: Halvorsen Ledgerworks (ACC-4007) got a dunning email for $102.00, but their open invoices only add up to $51.00. Fix the balance.

subject: Duplicate accounts from signup
body: Okafor & Lund Bakeries signed up three times during onboarding. Close the two extra accounts and keep the original.

subject: Enterprise loyalty discount
body: Finance approved the 10% loyalty discount for every active Enterprise customer, effective next cycle. Update their monthly price.

subject: Month-end write-offs
body: Month-end close: write off every open invoice that's 90+ days overdue (due on or before 2026-08-03) so the AR aging report is clean for Friday.

subject: October usage re-rate
body: The meter applied the wrong seat-day rate when it totalled October; the event log itself is right. Recompute every account's October usage charge from usage_events.

subject: SLA credit after outage
body: Larkspur Clinics (ACC-4022) was hit by the API outage on our status page. Issue the standard $50.00 SLA credit.

subject: Promo credits on the wrong account
body: The promo credits on the Vivid Dynamics account (ACC-4082) were applied by mistake; they never joined the promo. Remove them.

subject: Goodwill credit after October incidents
body: Per the incident review: every account that got an SLA-breach credit in October also gets a $25.00 goodwill credit.
